name: Call Out (P16)
desc: Before the flip, spend a ready Thumb to call out a rival: your ATK beats their BLK, they take +1; otherwise you take +1. With Posted Up: only crews at your Spot.

name: Pass the Tab (P12)
desc: The crew with the biggest damage this round may pay a Thumb to swap it with the next-worst crew, who may pass it on. 3 Thumbs each.

name: Specialist matrix
desc: 1st on either ATK or BLK takes 0 damage (Change Ladder L0.4).

name: Forecast
desc: From round 4, the Vein announces next round's rich Spot one round early.

name: 4 corners
desc: Play Corners with 4 corners instead of 3.

name: 3 Trigger Thumbs
desc: Everyone starts with 3 Thumbs instead of 2.

name: Short game (4 rounds)
desc: 4 rounds instead of 8, for quick rules checks.

name: Corner locations (P1)
desc: Each corner gets a location card with a small rule: Laundromat, Rooftop, Bodega, Precinct, Subway Grate, Old Church.

name: Block corner (P1+P2)
desc: The first corner is The Block: its holder gets +1 Rep a round on top of the usual pay.

name: Open first card (P1)
desc: Before casting, every crew shows one card and its corner; that card must lead the line there.

name: Rep upkeep
desc: Snowball fix: each corner held beyond the second costs 1 Rep a round.

name: Show lead card (P4)
desc: Turns on Run It Up, and before the fold / call / raise pick every crew sees each rival's first card (the one leading their line). Some information, not all of it.

name: Lead card: hide ATK/BLK
desc: Like Show lead card, but the number strip is covered: only name, elements and length show. Use instead of the full lead card.

name: Run It Up (P4)
desc: After casting, everyone picks at once: fold (skip the ranking, take 1), call, or raise (one raise ×2 matrix damage, two or more ×4).

name: Wheel without cooldown
desc: Every sector can land every round, like the physical Wheel. By default a sector that landed sits out the next 3 spins.

name: Hot corner (GP2)
desc: Each round the Vein runs hot at one random corner: holding it at the end of the round pays +1 Rep extra.

name: Physical deck (GP2 app)
desc: The cards are real: a cast may name any card, Swap Meet happens at the table. Used by the GP2 tabletop app; hidden in the web lobby.
